Class Application

java.lang.Object
Application
public class Application extends Object
Represents an application that a student would send Contains details application date, the student name who send and internship applied

      public Application(String ID, Internship opportunity, Student applicant)
      Constructor Instantiates an instance of an application
      Parameters:
      ID - the unique identification number of the application
      opportunity - the internship that the application corresponds to
      applicant - a Student class, corresponds to the Student user that is making the application

    • updateStatus

      public void updateStatus(String state)
      update the Status of the application Will print an error message if the input is invalid, in that instance, the status of the application will not change
      Parameters:
      state - the status of the application (valid states: 'Pending', 'Accepted', 'Unsuccessful', 'Withdrawn')
